data.long_meaning: Derived from the Germanic 'Rothari' or 'Hrodric', Roderic means 'famous ruler'. The name was borne by various European monarchs and saints throughout history.

data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Roderic can be found in its root meaning - 'ruling with God's power'. This name serves as a reminder that no matter our position in life, we are all called to rule with God's guidance and grace. It is a powerful reminder of the importance of humility, faith, and obedience to God's will, as we seek to rule our own lives and make a positive impact in the world around us.
